evals.prompt: My service `checkout-api` in workspace `payments-prod` just went CrashLoopBackOff. Tell me what's wrong and how to fix it.
evals.expected_output: Reads troubleshooting.md, resolves clusterId/namespace, lists pods, pulls previous container logs + events, classifies OOM vs probe vs app error, proposes a concrete manifest edit and asks approval before apply_manifest.
expectations: Does not conclude health from DEPLOY_SUCCESS or get_application alone
Calls list_k8s_pods (or equivalent) and inspects reason / container states before proposing a fix
Uses get_k8s_pod_logs with previous:true on CrashLoopBackOff
Corroborates exit 137 with events/metrics before calling it OOM
Edits from the live activeDeployment.manifest (full replace) and validates before apply
Asks for approval before apply_manifest

evals.prompt: Deploy this HuggingFace model for me: https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in workspace llm-dev. Use whatever GPU we have.
evals.expected_output: Resolves workspaceId, calls get_model_deployment_specs, handles gated HF token via secret FQN, prefers isAvailableInWorkspace, validates and applies a service manifest, then verifies pods and offers Gateway + smoke-test next steps.
expectations: Calls get_model_deployment_specs (not hand-written vLLM YAML from memory)
Resolves workspace via list_workspaces and uses workspace.id as workspaceId
Uses a secret FQN for HF token if the model is gated — never asks the user to paste the raw token
Prefers deployments with isAvailableInWorkspace: true
validate_manifest then apply_manifest; verifies with list_k8s_pods after apply
Mentions post-deploy smoke test and optional Gateway self-hosted registration

evals.prompt: get_model_deployment_specs failed for my any-to-any Hub model. Can we still deploy it?
evals.expected_output: Retries with an explicit pipelineTagOverride inferred from the model card / architecture, or uses similar-model recovery; does not give up at the first catalogue error.
expectations: Retries get_model_deployment_specs with pipelineTagOverride (e.g. text-generation or image-text-to-text) instead of stopping
Bases the override on Hub card / architecture family, not a random guess
If still failing, uses similar-model strategy (generate for sibling, swap artifact/model id) and re-validates
Does not invent a full vLLM service from scratch unless recovery requires it

evals.prompt: vLLM pod is OOMKilled on a single L4 even though the catalogue suggested that GPU. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Treats catalogue default gpu_memory_utilization (~0.90) as the likely culprit on small GPUs; lowers utilization / max length / switches quant or GPU; regenerates or patches args and applies with approval.
expectations: Checks main-container logs/events for CUDA OOM vs download failure
Calls out lowering gpu_memory_utilization (e.g. toward 0.70–0.80) on small GPUs rather than only adding more GPUs
Considers max model length / quantization / larger GPU as alternatives
Patches from live manifest or regenerates via get_model_deployment_specs, then validate + approval + apply

evals.prompt: My Helm app shows DEPLOY_SUCCESS but Argo is OutOfSync and pods never became Ready. Status in the UI looks stale.
evals.expected_output: Follows rollout-argocd playbook: sync_application when appropriate, checks tfy-agent health/logs, does not treat empty tool results as healthy.
expectations: Does not declare the app healthy from DEPLOY_SUCCESS alone
Uses sync_application / Argo sync guidance from failure-modes/rollout-argocd.md when OutOfSync
Checks tfy-agent / status publishing when UI state is stale
Treats empty list_k8s_* / log results as possible visibility gaps, not proof of health

evals.prompt: Scale my model service to zero when idle for 15 minutes, and pin chat sessions to the same replica for prefix cache.
evals.expected_output: Edits the live service manifest for auto-shutdown / Elasti scale-to-0 and sticky session label; explains cold-start and best-effort stickiness; validate + apply with approval.
expectations: Uses autoscaling / scale-to-0 fields from schema/docs (Elasti idle timeout), not pause/resume alone
Adds tfy_sticky_session_header_name (or schema-equivalent sticky config) and tells the client which header to send
Warns about cold start on scale-from-zero and best-effort sticky routing
Edits live manifest, validates, asks approval before apply

evals.prompt: Create a notebook in workspace ml-sandbox so I can explore this dataset, and give me the URL.
evals.expected_output: Authors a notebook application from schema, applies with approval, returns endpoint; covers OAuth/login expectations from notebook-ssh playbook.
expectations: Uses get_manifest_json_schema for notebook (not service)
Sets workspace_fqn correctly and validate_manifest before apply
Mentions auth / OAuth login behavior for notebook access
Returns generate_deployment_endpoint (or equivalent) after deploy

evals.prompt: list_application_events returned nothing for my model StatefulSet but the pod is CrashLooping. Is it healthy?
evals.expected_output: Does not treat empty application events as healthy; falls back to list_k8s_events / pod logs; notes StatefulSet event visibility caveat.
expectations: Does not conclude healthy from empty list_application_events
Falls back to list_k8s_events and get_k8s_pod_logs
Mentions that application-scoped events can miss StatefulSet-backed workloads
